title: Shipped by second game - Zero Page 1.0
author: lerugray
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/ym2c4x842p3h1.png?width=630&format=png&auto=webp&s=0dc0b138c3119206ba5cc278e9ff5b4b917b860b

Greetings all - have posted here about other projects I've done using claude code and my own stack as the engineer - just finished another project that was shipped today - a Zachtronics inspired programming puzzle game focused on 6502 assembly - 24 puzzles (3 hidden), there's a free demo, and a music video hidden somewhere in the shipped version along with a PDF manual, windows and mac builds. 

  
Feel free to tell me if you love it, hate it, etc - 

itch: [https://conflict-simulations-llc.itch.io/zero-page](https://conflict-simulations-llc.itch.io/zero-page)

Landing page: [https://lerugray.github.io/conflict-simulations-llc/zero-page/](https://lerugray.github.io/conflict-simulations-llc/zero-page/)
